risks.note: A Provisional Attachment Order (No. 09/2024) issued by the Directorate of Enforcement, Gurugram Zonal Office, attached shares held by the Company's promoter and froze some of the Company's bank accounts; the order was confirmed by the Adjudicating Authority and is under appeal before the Appellate Authority, sub judice.

The Company's accumulated losses stood at Rs. 12,435.07 lakhs as at 31 March 2026; results are prepared on a going-concern basis premised on management's confidence in the Company's ability to continue as a going concern.
The Company did not take any credit rating during FY2025-26, leaving lenders/investors without an independent third-party assessment of its credit quality.

The Company disposed of its entire investment in its subsidiary RT Packaging Limited (13 November 2025) and its joint venture Rollatainers-Toyo Machine Private Limited (30 December 2025), removing these entities from consolidation going forward.
